text:
maria-peopleops: FYI new hire Matt P starts 4/5 remote from UK. BG vendor flagged international address verification and wants a secondary ID. Also need to confirm W-8BEN vs W-4 for tax forms.

raj-recruiter: He accepted last week. Matt said he can provide a UK driver's license and a utility bill for address. He prefers laptop shipped to his UK address and to do orientation in our EMEA window.

maria-peopleops: Policy: for international hires we require 2 IDs (one government) + proof of local address within 30 days. For I-9 specifically, US law requires in-person or authorized agent for US-based I-9s. Since he's remote in UK, I-9 doesn't apply, but payroll/tax docs differ. We need to route to payroll for W-8BEN guidance.

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK UPDATE: Matt P 176894600 0: manual review - missing secondary ID. Requested docs sent 1767895200.

it-ops: For laptop shipping internationally we need customs info & a shipped-value waiver. We can ship standard kit via DHL express. Will hold until BG clears or until People Ops signs off. Shipping ETA ~5-7 business days. Ask candidate to confirm pickup location and sign restrictions.

maria-peopleops: Can someone draft the docs request? I'll include benefits enrollment window too (they need to enroll within 30 days of start or wait until open enrollment).

raj-recruiter: I'll send this template and ping him now. Template: 
---
Hi Matt, quick checklist to finish onboarding before 4/5:
1) Upload a photo of your primary government ID (passport or UK driving license) to https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire
2) Upload a secondary ID or proof of address (recent utility bill or bank statement)
3) Confirm preferred shipping address for laptop + phone and whether you accept courier customs handling fees
4) For tax: are you a US citizen/green card holder? If not, we'll send W-8BEN to sign.
Please reply with pdfs and preferred timezone for orientation.
Thanks, Raj (Recruiting)
---

maria-peopleops: Good. Also include benefits note: elect medical/dental within 30 days; if not elected we'll auto-enroll in base plan (UK hires get local benefits guidance). Add a line about mandatory data privacy acknowledgment.

newhire-matt: Thanks all 1767894900 0: I uploaded passport + UK driving license a few minutes ago and attached a PDF bill. I prefer DHL to my home address and happy to cover customs handling. My timezone is GMT. Can orientation be at 09:00 GMT?

it-ops: Got the shipping request. We'll queue the package with "signature required" and customs invoice. Please confirm once BG clears and People Ops signs off.

maria-people-ops: I'll confirm benefits onboarding and send payroll W-8BEN if Raj confirms non-US. Quick action items: Raj to confirm citizenship status, BG vendor to mark docs received, Payroll to prepare W-8BEN, IT to hold shipment until clearance. I'll follow up here once BG vendor closes the review. :sparkles:
